name: Picsart
tagline: AI image, video and audio tools
description: Picsart lets agents generate and edit images, videos, and audio with AI tools such as background removal and upscaling. Some tools use Picsart credits.

prompts.text: Remove the background from this product photo.
Upscale this image to twice its size.
Generate a banner image for a coffee shop opening.

apps.name: Picsart
apps.description: Image, video, and audio generation and editing, over Picsart's MCP server with browser sign-in.
